roles.description: Primary human-readable name for a product, component, extension, or named object.
Heading text that introduces a section or content group.
Informational content explicitly distinguished from warnings and errors.
Visible label for a control, command, field, navigation target, or data item.
A complete list value or list-oriented metadata string.
Standalone application or diagnostic message presented to the user.
Non-blocking notice that calls attention to important contextual information.
Temporary input text that illustrates the expected value or search scope.
Current state or progress text that may change as an operation proceeds.
Literal language syntax or a syntax-bearing template shown to users.
General user-facing text without a more specific linguistic role.
Title for a window, dialog, command, page, panel, report, or other named surface.
Warning content that communicates risk or a condition requiring attention.
Localized keyboard mnemonic associated with a visible control label.
Non-visible accessible name used when visible content does not name an interface element.
Text alternative that conveys the purpose or content of a non-text element.
Text intended for an assistive-technology live region or equivalent announcement.
Caption associated with a table, figure, media item, preview, or other content object.
Explanatory description of a setting, control, component, option, or result.
Supplemental detail that expands a message, error, dialog, or operation result.
Error content describing a failed operation or invalid condition.
Example value, command, syntax fragment, or usage illustration.
Contextual help text that explains behavior or available actions.
Short hint about input format, expected behavior, or a useful next action.
Instruction that tells the user how to complete a task or resolve a condition.
Text representing one item in a list, tree, collection, or result set.

Paths or hyperlink text partially of fully reflecting app folder structure. These might include document names in need of translation. If a full translation includes folder structure this directly affects code. Testing would be advised.
Text for one selectable option, choice, mode, or preference value.
Plural-sensitive message or quantity text requiring locale-aware selection.
Prompt requesting input, confirmation, or another user response.
Interrogative text presented as a question to the user.
Displayed keyboard shortcut or key-chord text.
Condensed result, count, coverage statement, or operation overview.
Concise hover or focus help for a control or interface element.
Displayed value text associated with a field, property, metric, or state.
